description.value: Richmond eBike is a Metro Vancouver e-bike specialist that has been selling and servicing electric bikes, trikes, scooters, and mobility solutions since 2014. The shop carries a broad inventory of parts and accessories — from motors and controllers to tires, chains, and drivetrain components — and runs a dedicated repair workshop servicing all brands including ICBC inspections. Touring cyclists riding e-bikes will find one of the more complete electric-bike service and parts resources in the region here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at richmondebike.com confirms an active, real e-bike retail and repair shop serving Metro Vancouver since 2014, with explicit repair services ('Electric Bike Repair', 'Repairs for all brands', 'ICBC Inspection & Repair') supporting the mechanicals criterion. The site lists a 'Rental' page under E-Bike Service and an extensive parts inventory (tires, tubes, chains, brakes, derailleurs) supporting several optional amenities. A notable name mismatch exists: OSM records the business as 'EBike Canada' while the website is consistently branded 'Richmond eBike' / 'RICHMOND E-BIKE'.
